assertions.text: Classifies the finding as round 1 -> Fix path (not filed, not declined)
States plainly that verification is a hard precondition before any reply/resolve action -- the reply is never sent and the thread is never resolved on the strength of a pushed commit alone
Describes committing via Skill(git-kit:commit), not a raw `git commit`
The drafted reply cites both a fixing commit SHA and a one-line summary of what verification confirmed
States the thread is resolved only after that reply, and only because verification actually passed
